evidence.field: File description: file identity, source links, rights, upload date and original-file link
evidence.text: The exact file page describes 院-seal.svg as a digital vector depicting 院 in Shuowen seal-script style. It lists Sinica Database and other character databases as sources, gives an original-file link, records the file upload as 8 August 2016, and states that the SVG representation is public domain with attribution appreciated but not required. This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph; the description does not independently authenticate the historical form.

The description page still establishes the file identity, its stated rights and its modern redraw status; a consuming harness should treat any download failure as an unavailable image candidate rather than infer its appearance.

search_audit.outcome: Found and opened the exact Commons file description page. It identifies a Shuowen seal-style digital vector, gives source links, links the original file and states public-domain terms. The original URL could not be opened in the browser tool.

search_audit.outcome: Search results did not provide an inspectable primary 院 manuscript image. The previously cited Qin-slip evidence remains text-only in this packet; no artifact glyph candidate was established.

search_audit.outcome: Opened the exact 院 query URL and the database root. Both returned the query interface without character-form records or images. No Xiaoxuetang image was selected.

gaps: The Commons original SVG URL could not be opened, so its pixels were not inspected here. Its exact file description page does establish the candidate's label as a modern Shuowen seal-style digital redraw, source links, upload date and public-domain claim.
The exact Xiaoxuetang 院 query page returned only the database interface, not glyph records. No image or official rights notice for an individual selected image was used.
No usable primary artifact or manuscript image of 院 was established in this pass. The supplied historical accounts remain text evidence and do not provide a verified image of an early form.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; digital file uploaded 2016-08-08
items.caption: Modern vector redraw labelled as 院 in Shuowen seal-script style; it illustrates a transmitted seal-style form, not an excavated artifact.
items.alt: Digital vector rendering of 院 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons file page identifies the character and script-style label, names source databases and states reuse terms. It can illustrate the transmitted seal-style form, provided the image is successfully retrieved; it is not evidence for an artifact chronology or the disputed 院/寏 relationship.
items.rights: The Commons description page states that the SVG representation is public domain; attribution is not required but appreciated.

limitations.text: The SVG's original URL was inaccessible to this browser during research, so the pixels were not inspected. The proposed candidate should be discarded if the harness cannot retrieve it; no artifact image was verified.
No early manuscript or artifact image was established. The Shuowen-style vector is a modern redraw and cannot resolve the competing transmitted 院 and 寏 analyses.
